text: Linux camera bridge: remote USB capture via gphoto2
description: Local helper on the Linux laptop that triggers the tethered Sony Alpha 6400 (gphoto2 2.5.32: "Sony ILCE-6400 (PC Control)" — camera USB mode must be set to PC Remote) and pulls the full-res image straight into the capture flow — no touching the camera, so position stays fixed. Optional live view for framing. Fallback: Pixel 10a via browser upload. Open: capture UI local next to the bridge (recommended) vs. on the live site calling localhost.

status.comment: Verified 2026-11-02 with the real Sony A6400 (PC Remote): bridge /capture returned a 6000x4000 JPEG in 1.7 s. First attempt timed out (~40 s, no picture, likely focus/wake-up); error now includes gphoto2 output.
